title: Glasgow Hotel Deals: City Centre, West End & Riverside
description: Compare Glasgow hotel prices on every big booking site. Stay in the Merchant City, the West End or by the river near the big concert venues and SEC.
intro: Live music, galleries and grand Victorian streets: compare Glasgow hotel prices for your dates on every site.

sections.html: The SEC and the OVO Hydro by the River Clyde host big concerts and conferences, and hotels nearby fill fast on event nights. Compare early, or stay in the centre and take a short train or taxi.

faqs.q: Is Glasgow good value for a city break?
faqs.a: Glasgow often has a wide choice of hotels across the centre, the West End and the riverside, so comparing sites can turn up good value, especially away from big event nights.
